$comment: What the sentences the site writes about the data may contain (CLAUDE.md invariant 8: a template names no domain value, figure or year, says what the data shows and never why). pipeline/tests/test_site_config.py holds every new template in config to this file. banned_words is the linted list of causal and judgement words. placeholders names what the code fills for each kind of template; an entry ending .* allows any path beneath it.
$ordinary_words_comment: Names from the reference files that are also plain words in a sentence and so may appear in a template. pipeline/tests/test_site_config.py fails a template that names any other value or label. Empty today.
